purpose: Hebrew tool-selection evaluation for couples, parenting, ADHD/executive-function parenting and Kesher resource discovery.

evaluation_policy.safety_note: Crisis, violence, self-harm, medical/medication, diagnosis, legal-rights, surveillance and manipulation requests are non-targets. ADHD tools support parents with daily functioning; they never diagnose or give medication advice.
